intent: Advance the NovaPulse engine from Phase 1 to Phase 2 by implementing a full-featured 2D physics engine, including broadphase spatial partitioning and narrowphase collision resolution.
architecture_impact: Introduced a modular physics pipeline (Spatial Hash -> Narrowphase -> Resolver) that decouples collision detection from ECS logic. Added new component types (RigidBodyComponent) to support physical interactions, shifting the engine from simple kinematic movement to dynamic, impulse-based physics.

{'file': 'src/physics/narrowphase.js', 'change_summary': 'Added pure function-based collision detection to generate manifolds for intersecting shapes.'}
{'file': 'src/physics/resolver.js', 'change_summary': 'Implemented impulse-based resolution with positional correction for physical response.'}
{'file': 'src/ecs/components.js', 'change_summary': 'Added RigidBodyComponent to store mass, restitution, and friction properties.'}
{'file': 'src/main.js', 'change_summary': 'Updated bootstrap logic to initialize the new physics subsystems.'}
functionality_gained: The engine can now handle complex physical interactions between entities, including collision detection, response, and performance-optimized spatial querying, verified by a new scratchpad debugging tool.
